description: This PHP source file defines the TimeModuleController class within the OrangeHRM Time module. The class extends AbstractModuleController and contains a handle() method that retrieves the default path for the Time module and redirects the user to that location.

classes.name: TimeModuleController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling requests related to the Time module in OrangeHRM. It extends AbstractModuleController and primarily performs redirection to the default Time module page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming request for the Time module, retrieves the default path via getHomePageService(), and redirects the user to that page.
